transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, your Battalion S-6. I'll be publishing the binding network access plan for tomorrow once we've gathered service requirements from each of you. As a reminder, we have three protected network segments available — Red, Blue, and Green — and three service windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Each service gets one segment and one window. I need to hear from the operations, logistics, and medical representatives on your requirements for the command video brief, logistics synchronization feed, and clinic records system respectively. Also note that each service must have a documented configuration control before its access window begins, so please flag any dependencies on that front. Who'd like to start?
